takeaway: When you save photos 'to the cloud,' they are copied and stored on thousands of powerful computers in massive, secure warehouses called data centers.
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your 'cloud' isn't a fluffy thing in the sky! It's actually massive, secure buildings.

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 When you save photos, they're copied onto thousands of computers.
🔹 These computers are housed in giant warehouses called data centers.
🔹 Many data centers are the size of multiple football fields!
🔹 They run 24/7 with immense power and cooling systems.
